name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, with image references
version: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (distilled, 4 steps) with Qwen3 4B text encoder
summary: A modern image model that can be given your reference pictures themselves, not just words.
details: Black Forest Labs’ small FLUX.2 model. Atlas gives it up to four reference pictures, each prepared for what it is for (a layout sketch for composition, a blurred study of light and colour for atmosphere, a close-up swatch for material, the picture itself for a subject) and the model paints a new picture from your description. It also edits a picture while looking at references. It is steered in words, so it follows a reference’s look and subject well, its layout and materials less exactly, and a face as a likeness, not the exact person. Four steps per picture, so it is fast for its quality.
